newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP shares fall on CIC bid report.
newsitem.headline: BNP shares fall on CIC bid report.

text.p: Shares in Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) fell after a report in daily Le Monde which said the bank would bid for soon-to-be-privatised CIC, which is owned by French insurer GAN.
BNP's stock was off 1.02 percent or two francs at 195 francs at 1100 GMT, off its low of 194.5 francs reached right after the announcement.
BNP said it would not confirm, deny or make any immediate comment on the report when contacted by Reuters.
The government is selling 67 percent of Credit Industriel et Commercial (CIC) and a tender for offers closes at 1600 GMT on Monday.
Afternoon daily Le Monde said BNP met on Friday to decide its final position and would make an offer without its partner Dresdner Bank but with the consent of the German bank.
The stock accelerated its decline, losing 1.68 percent to 193.70 francs at 1120 GMT.
